title: Daily Helper Receipt Generator
name: Daily Helper Receipt
summary: Monthly pay receipt for a household helper.
description: Create a salary receipt for a daily helper such as a maid or a cook, with the role, month, amount and payment mode. Preview instantly and download as PDF.
intro: A daily helper receipt records the monthly pay of a maid, a cook or another household helper. It shows the role, the month, the amount and how it was paid.

print.title: Daily Helper Receipt
print.certify: This is to certify that {employer} has paid {amount} to {helper}, who is working as {role}, towards salary for the month of {month} (acknowledged receipt enclosed).
print.certify_self: This is to certify that I have paid {amount} to {helper}, who is working as {role}, for the month of {month} (acknowledged receipt enclosed).
print.reimburse: Please reimburse the above amount. I further declare that what is stated above is correct and true.
print.received_text: Received from {employer} the sum of {amount} by {helper} ({role}) towards salary for the month of {month}.
print.received_sum: Received a sum of {amount} only for the month of {month} from {employer}.

sample.declaration: I also declare that the helper is exclusively utilized for official purposes only.
